# ImageTracer.js 1.2.6

Author: Andras Jankovics (andras@jankovics.net)
Source: https://github.com/jankovicsandras/imagetracerjs
Pinned commit: cb0c84a309df5e75614d3b5166cdc77a56f12a98
License: Unlicense / public domain; see LICENSE and the original source header.
The vendored source is unmodified. No remote CDN is used.

Infinitools provides its own bounded worker, deterministic palette, SVG
serialization, input validation and interface. VectorCraft inspired the feature
selection; its Rust code and branding are not included in this implementation.
